intuition: A list provides constant-time random indexing, while a dictionary maps each value to its list position for constant-time updates.

brute_force.approach: Use a list and scan linearly to find a value during removal.

optimal.approach: Track values in a list and value-to-index map; remove by swapping the last value into the deleted slot.

edge_cases: Inserting an existing value returns False without changing state.
Removing an absent value returns False.
getRandom may return any current member, so tests check membership.
